scripts.bootstrap:local: npm run localstack && npm run cdklocal bootstrap --all
scripts.cdklocal: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=eu-central-1 cdklocal --app 'npx tsx local.dev.ts'
scripts.deploy:local: npm run localstack && npm run bootstrap:local && npm run cdklocal deploy -- --all
scripts.dev: npm run localstack && npm run cdklocal watch
scripts.remove:local: npm run localstack && npm run cdklocal destroy -- --all
